summary_md: **恒星sun ([@vintcessun](https://x.com/vintcessun/status/2115776170633597275))** explains **Spine** ([arXiv 2610.37224](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37224)) for long-horizon coding agents: the agent declares work scopes, the runtime stores subtasks, interactions and completion state in a SpineTree, keeps details of unfinished work while collapsing finished subtasks to results, and delegates only parallelizable work; reported gains are +11.8% on SWE-Milestone at 32.4% lower cost, and 73.7% cheaper than recursive sub-agents.
